releaseNotes: Fix: ESP32-S3 boards (AMOLED/5"/7") now use DIO flash mode instead of QIO. QIO could cause an affected physical unit to boot-loop indefinitely and never start (blank screen, no serial) -- DIO is fully compatible with any QIO-capable flash chip with no practical downside for this app.
